stem: The cognitive flexibility of successful fictional detectives is often ____ by their cultural ambivalence: detectives’ intellectual acumen, it seems, exists in direct proportion to their uneasy place in society.
The scientist’s motivation for (i)____ a ban on the food addictive cannot be called (ii)____. He himself had a patent for the substitution for the addictive food.
Since the field of quantum mechanics is often considered to be (i)____, it was surprising to find it attracts so much (ii)____ interest.

To get funding and tenured positions, medical researchers have to get their work published in well-regarded journals, where rejection can climb above 90 percent. Not surprisingly, the studies that tend to make the grade are those that make (i)____ claims. But while coming up with such (ii)____ claims is relatively easy, getting the data to bear them out is another matter. When studied rigorously, the great majority of these claims (iii)____.

Ancient cave painters explored every surface, and although they bypassed certain walls that to us seem just as suitable for decoration as ones they chose, the placement of the art apparently wasn’t ____.
Although many skeptics of the scientific theory ____ critiques that have long since been disproved, some of the doubters arguably bring up valid points.
Although the employees’ union and company management, entering into contract negotiations, both issued statements encouraging ____, acrimony between the two sides continued unabated.
